posts.trend: "This Is Hell": Bengaluru Man Raises Traffic Concerns Over Nearly 2-Hour Office Commute
posts.context: Our parents' generation had simple commutes and struggles to comprehend the logistical warfare of modern Indian IT corridors.
posts.angle: To people who worked in 1995, ten kilometers is a brief morning stroll.
slides: "Beta, office toh paas mein hi hai na?"

"It's only ten kilometers."
"Why do you look like you survived a war?"
"Why is your laptop bag covered in mud?"

They think you sit in an air-conditioned room.

They don't know about the service lane.
posts.caption: Your parents still think computer work is a restful sitting job.
posts.rank_verdict: The dialogue in the middle slide feels too staged and theatrical to pass as a reported real-life exchange.
